captions.detailed: A compact point-of-sale cash register with a dark grey, angled housing. It features a slanted keypad with light grey buttons, a couple of blue function keys, a front-facing bill drawer with a handle slot, and a small, raised operator display screen. The bill drawer slides forward along a prismatic joint, while the operator screen can swivel on a vertical revolute joint at the back right corner.
captions.instruction: Generate a dark grey point-of-sale cash register with an angled keypad housing, light grey and blue buttons, a front-facing sliding bill drawer, and a swiveling rear operator display screen. Ensure the drawer moves along a prismatic joint and the display swivels on a vertical revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main register housing using a combination of box primitives and wedge-like cuts to form the angled keypad surface. Create the keypad buttons and auxiliary keys as small arrayed boxes. Model the sliding bill drawer as a box with a handle slot, and connect it to the housing via a prismatic joint. Construct the operator screen assembly using cylinders for the mounting post and a box with a recessed colored face for the screen, attaching it to the housing via a revolute joint.
